'''Ash Ketchum''' (Japanese: '''サトシ''' '' Satoshi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[A Ripple in Time]]''. He is closely based on {{Ash}} as he is depicted in the [[original series]]. 

Ash was first seen battling [[Arsham]] in a match of a [[Pokémon League]]. During the battle, he spotted a {{p|Celebi}} that took away his concentration. As soon as the Pokémon's attacks collided and Celebi was hit, Ash and Pikachu ended up in Future Forest. The two of them then ran after the [[Mythical Pokémon]] and went through several places until they reached a house where they finally met Celebi and {{p|Dialga}}.
